scenario: A prep cook handles raw chicken while wearing gloves, then removes and discards the gloves. Inspection confirms the cook's hands underneath the gloves were visibly clean and dry. The cook proceeds directly to chopping vegetables without washing hands first.
policy: Food employees must wash hands in a designated handwashing sink after handling raw animal products, before any subsequent task, except when the employee removes and discards gloves worn during the raw-product handling and the hands underneath remained visibly clean and dry, in which case immediate handwashing may be deferred until the next scheduled break.
question: Did the cook violate the handwashing requirement by proceeding without washing?
